svg.title: Without rig, the laptop runs out of memory. With rig, it runs only the agents.
svg.desc: Left: without rig, the laptop runs an agent, a dev server, Chrome and tests for every task, and memory is full. Right: with rig, the laptop runs only the agents and each branch gets a cloud desktop with its dev server, Chrome and tests.
svg.text: With rig · your laptop and the cloud
Two or three tasks in, the laptop swaps and freezes.
Your laptop runs only the agents.
The heavy work runs in one cloud desktop per branch.
